kids.name: words
kids.chars: in the one documented tool (Sierra Chart) the developing value area is a study input, not a labelled state on the chart, and the POC and value area are marked by highlighted letters or blocks rather than words. Whether TradingView or DeepCharts distinguish a developing value area at all is not established (their rows are unsourced). PD-1 and PD-2 rest on F-1..F-3 and F-11, not on this review. CMP-183's four period words match DeepCharts' list (`15` :2370), possibly the origin of F-7's fourth vocabulary (heuristic). The tool the Owner already uses is asked in the protocol (T0), not guessed.
